This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |

- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

19	### 2.1 logprob、top-k 与 rank(对数概率三件套)

22	
23	- **logprob**:该 token 的对数概率。取值 \( \le 0 \),越接近 0 表示模型越确信(概率越接近 1)。
24	- **top-k 候选**:按分数排序的前 k 个候选 token 及其分数,即 `top_logprobs`。
25	- **rank**:被采样 token 在分布中的名次。PegaInfer 的契约采用 vLLM 约定:**词表中 logit 不小于该 token 的个数(含并列)**,所以 `rank = 1` 表示它是最优 token,`rank = 3` 表示有两个以上的 token 比它强。见 `TokenLogprob` 的字段注释([pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/event.rs:4-9](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/event.rs#L4-L9))。

71

80	
81	分支表(全文只有两个分支、三种结局):
82	
83	| `scripted_completion` | `emit_count` | 输出内容 | `finish_reason` |
84	|---|---|---|---|
85	| 空(默认) | `max_tokens` | 循环复用 prompt token(见 4.2) | 恒为 `Length` |

87	| 非空,且 `max_tokens >= len(script)` | `len(script)` | `script` 全文 | `Stop`(自然放完) |
88	
89	统一成公式:
90	
91	\[
92	\text{emit\_count} = \begin{cases} \text{max\_tokens} & \text{script 为空} \\ \min(\text{max\_tokens},\ |\text{script}|) & \text{script 非空} \end{cases}
93	\]
94	
95	\[
96	\text{finish} = \begin{cases} \text{Stop} & \text{script 非空且 emit\_count} = |\text{script}| \\ \text{Length} & \text{其他一切情况} \end{cases}
97	\]

103	    script = config.scripted_completion
104	    if script 为空:
105	        emit_count = max_tokens
106	        tokens[i] = fake_token_id(prompt_tokens, i, config.fallback_token_id)   # 循环复用

109	        emit_count = min(max_tokens, len(script))

197	### 4.2 fake_token_id:循环复用 prompt token 与空 prompt 回退
198	
199	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
200	
201	脚本为空时,引擎仍要发 `max_tokens` 个**真实存在的 token id**。约束是:发出去的 id 必须能被 tokenizer 解码成文本——前端要把它渲染成 OpenAI 响应的 `text` 字段,一个词表外的 id 会让 detokenize 失败。最省事的保证:**直接用 prompt 里出现过的 token**。prompt 既然被送进了引擎,它的每个 id 天然在词表内。于是策略是按位置循环复用:
202	
203	\[
204	\text{token}(i) = \text{prompt}[i \bmod |\text{prompt}|]
205	\]
206	
207	副作用反而成了特性:输出看起来像输入的复读(prompt = "你好" 输出近似 "你好你好…"),在 e2e 日志里一眼可辨,不会和真模型输出混淆。
208	
209	**空 prompt 的坑**:`[] \bmod 0` 是除零。此时没有可复用的 token,走 `fallback_token_id`——一个配置旋钮(`with_fallback_token_id`,默认 0),由调用方保证它是个合法 id。这就是「fake token 对空 prompt 走 fallback 的必要性」:**循环复用这条路径在数学上对空序列不成立**,必须有一条独立的出口。
210	
211	#### 4.2.2 核心流程

213	```
214	fake_token_id(prompt_tokens, index, fallback_token_id):
215	    if prompt_tokens 为空: return fallback_token_id
216	    else:                   return prompt_tokens[index % len(prompt_tokens)]
217	```

222	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
223	| 输出 | 7 | 9 | 7 | 9 | 7 |
224	
225	`max_tokens = 3` 时输出 `[7, 9, 7]`;`max_tokens = 5` 时输出 `[7, 9, 7, 9, 7]`。

281	### 4.3 logprobs::prompt 与 logprobs::completion:协议夹具合成
282	
283	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
284	
285	前端把 `logprobs` / `prompt_logprobs` 请求参数翻译成 `Request` 上的两个 `Option<usize>` 字段(`usize` 是 top-k 档位)。引擎若不管它们,前端协议层关于 logprobs 的序列化、透传、SSE 分片就永远测不到。模拟引擎的做法:在**发 token 的同一个位置**顺路合成夹具——
286	
287	- 请求带 `prompt_logprobs` → 准入时(legacy 车道)一次性 `echo_prompt`,内容是 `logprobs::prompt(prompt_tokens, top_k)` 合成的 `PromptEcho`;
288	- 请求带 `logprobs` → 每发一个 token,配一个 `logprobs::completion(token, top_k)` 合成的 `TokenLogprob`,与 token 一起 `push_tokens`。
289	
290	夹具数值全是常数(见 4.3.3),协议含义才是重点:**prompt 回显首位 `None`**(首 token 无上文,模型打不了分)、**prompt 的 rank = 3**(假装排在第三)、**completion 的 rank = 1**(假装采样 token 就是最优解)。这样前端两条路径(带 rank 的、不带 rank 的、首位 None 的)都能在 CPU 上走到。
291	
292	还有一个空 prompt 的协议细节:profiled 车道里,若 `prompt_echo.ids` 为空(空 prompt + prompt_logprobs),会在准入当步立刻 `echo_prompt` 清掉这个待办([src/lib.rs:347-359](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/lib.rs#L347-L359)),不留悬空状态。
293	
294	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
295	
296	```
297	logprobs::prompt(ids, top_k) -> PromptEcho:
298	    对 ids 逐个位置 i:
299	        i == 0  → None                      # 协议:首位置无上文,不打分
300	        i > 0   → TokenLogprob {
301	                    logprob:  -2.5,          # 常数
302	                    rank:     3,             # 假装第三名
303	                    top_logprobs: alternatives(ids[i], top_k)
304	                  }
305	    返回 PromptEcho { ids: ids 原样回显, logprobs: 上述向量 }
306	
307	logprobs::completion(id, top_k) -> TokenLogprob:
308	    TokenLogprob { logprob: -0.25, rank: 1, top_logprobs: alternatives(id, top_k) }
309	```
310	
311	legacy 车道的挂接时机(与 u2-l1 的三段式对齐):
312	
313	- 准入循环:`if let Some(top_k) = request.prompt_logprobs { ledger.echo_prompt(id, logprobs::prompt(...)) }`——prompt 回显在准入时一次发清;
314	- 推进循环:每个到期 token 上 `running.logprobs.map(|top_k| logprobs::completion(token, top_k))`,有则 `vec![Some(lp)]`(与单 token 平行),无则空 `Vec`。

317	
318	**四个常数**——[src/logprobs.rs:4-7](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/logprobs.rs#L4-L7):`PROMPT_LOGPROB = -2.5`、`PROMPT_RANK = 3`、`COMPLETION_LOGPROB = -0.25`、`FIRST_ALTERNATIVE_LOGPROB = -1.0`。注意 prompt 分数(-2.5)比 completion 分数(-0.25)低一个量级、rank 更差——夹具在数值上也做出了「prompt 复述的 token 排名靠后、生成 token 是首选」的假象,让两个路径的输出在日志里可区分。

375	### 4.4 alternatives:不含被计分 token 的候选表
376	
377	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
378	
379	`top_logprobs: Vec<(u32, f32)>` 是 top-k 候选列表。夹具的生成规则极简:从「被计分 token 的 id + 1」开始,连发 `top_k` 个 id,分数从 -1.0 起每个递减 1。两条硬规则藏在文档注释里:
380	
381	1. **候选表故意不含被计分的 token 本身**;
382	2. **这些分数不是模型精度证据**。
383	
384	为什么刻意排除?因为一旦候选表包含被计分 token,它就携带了一个隐含承诺——「表中该 token 的分数应与外层 `logprob` 字段一致」。模拟引擎根本没有分布,无法兑现这个承诺;排除它,夹具就只是「形状正确的占位数」,任何消费方都不会误读成真实的概率分布。配套的第二条规则是对测试作者的约束:断言只能针对**形状**(长度、平行性、可序列化),不能针对**数值含义**(比如「top1 分数一定最高所以生成 token 应为 top1」)。
385	
386	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
387	
388	```
389	alternatives(scored_id, top_k):
390	    for index in 0..top_k:
391	        id    = scored_id.wrapping_add(index + 1)     # 永不等于 scored_id
392	        score = -1.0 - index                          # 严格递减:-1.0, -2.0, -3.0, ...
393	```
394	
395	例:`alternatives(9, 3)` = `[(10, -1.0), (11, -2.0), (12, -3.0)]`。
396	
397	`wrapping_add` 的用意:即使 `scored_id` 逼近 `u32::MAX`,加法回绕后得到的仍是**彼此不同、且不等于 scored_id** 的小 id——唯一性不靠溢出检查,靠回绕语义天然保证(只要 `top_k < 2^32`)。
398	
399	#### 4.4.3 源码精读
400	
401	**alternatives 本体与两条注释**——[src/logprobs.rs:35-46](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/logprobs.rs#L35-L46):文档注释原文「Protocol fixtures deliberately keep the scored token out of the alternatives. These scores are not model accuracy evidence.」,函数体即上述两行算式。
402	
403	**两处调用**——prompt 侧 [src/logprobs.rs:17](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/logprobs.rs#L17) 与 completion 侧 [src/logprobs.rs:31](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/logprobs.rs#L31),都以「被计分的那个 id」为种子,保证候选表与主分描述的是同一个分布位置。
404	
405	#### 4.4.4 代码实践(手算 + 断言)
406	
407	1. **实践目标**:验证候选表的生成算式与「不含被计分 token」约定。
408	
409	2. **操作步骤**:先手算 `alternatives(9, 3)` 与 `alternatives(u32::MAX, 2)`,再在 tests 模块加断言(示例代码):
410	
411	   ```rust
412	   // 示例代码:候选表算式与排除约定
413	   #[test]
414	   fn my_alternatives_exclude_scored_token() {
415	       let alts = crate::logprobs::alternatives(9, 3);
416	       assert_eq!(alts, vec![(10, -1.0), (11, -2.0), (12, -3.0)]);
417	       assert!(!alts.iter().any(|(id, _)| *id == 9));   // 被计分 token 不在表内
418	
419	       let edge = crate::logprobs::alternatives(u32::MAX, 2);
420	       assert_eq!(edge, vec![(0, -1.0), (1, -2.0)]);    // 回绕后仍互异
421	       assert!(!edge.iter().any(|(id, _)| *id == u32::MAX));
422	   }
423	   ```
424	
425	   运行:`cargo test --release -p pegainfer-sim --lib my_alternatives`
426	
427	3. **需要观察的现象**:`u32::MAX` 情形没有 panic——`wrapping_add` 吸收了溢出;回绕出的 0、1 与 `u32::MAX` 互不相同。
428	
429	4. **预期结果**:断言通过。`alternatives` 是 `pub(super) fn`,与 4.3.4 同理可从 tests 模块直达。
430	
431	#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案
432	
433	**练习 1**:如果某测试断言「completion 的 top_logprobs 中排名第一的 id 应等于被生成的 token id」,这个断言错在哪?
434	
435	**答案**:违反夹具的两条明文规则。候选表被刻意排除被计分 token,且分数只是占位、不代表任何真实分布;这样的断言把夹具数值当成了模型精度证据,必然失败(表内 id 是 `token_id + 1` 起步)。正确的断言对象是形状:长度等于 top-k、条目可序列化、与主帧平行。
436	
437	**练习 2**:`top_k = 0` 时 `alternatives` 返回什么?这合法吗?
438	
439	**答案**:返回空 `Vec`(`0..0` 不产生元素)。在引擎侧这不会发生——`Request.logprobs` 的构造约定是 `(logprobs > 0).then_some(logprobs)`(见 [src/lib.rs:830](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/lib.rs#L830)),0 档会折算成 `None`(即「不开」),根本走不到夹具。
440	
441	## 5. 综合实践
442	
443	**任务:写一个「输出推演器」,与引擎对拍。**
444	
445	把本讲的知识压缩成一个纯函数,再用真实引擎验证它——这是「读源码建立起可执行模型」的终极检验。
446	
447	1. **实践目标**:不调用 `planned_completion`,凭分支表手写 `predict`,与 `collect_completion` 的真实输出逐位对拍,覆盖全部分支与边界。
448	
449	2. **操作步骤**:
450	   - 在 `mod tests` 里新增(示例代码):
451	
452	     ```rust
453	     // 示例代码:手写推演器,与引擎对拍
454	     fn predict(script: &[u32], prompt: &[u32], max_tokens: usize, fallback: u32) -> (Vec<u32>, FinishReason) {
455	         if script.is_empty() {
456	             let tokens = (0..max_tokens)
457	                 .map(|i| if prompt.is_empty() { fallback } else { prompt[i % prompt.len()] })
458	                 .collect();
459	             (tokens, FinishReason::Length)
460	         } else {
461	             let emit = max_tokens.min(script.len());
462	             let (tokens, reason) = if emit == script.len() {
463	                 (script.to_vec(), FinishReason::Stop)
464	             } else {
465	                 (script[..emit].to_vec(), FinishReason::Length)
466	             };
467	             (tokens, reason)
468	         }
469	     }
470

473	         let cases: Vec<(Vec<u32>, Vec<u32>, usize, u32)> = vec![
474	             (vec![], vec![7, 9], 3, 42),          // 无脚本:循环 prompt
475	             (vec![], vec![], 2, 42),               // 无脚本:空 prompt 回退
476	             (vec![11, 22, 33], vec![7, 9], 8, 42), // 脚本放完:Stop
477	             (vec![11, 22, 33], vec![7], 2, 42),    // 脚本截断:Length
478	             (vec![11, 22, 33], vec![7], 3, 42),    // 边界:恰好相等也是 Stop
479	         ];
480	         for (script, prompt, max_tokens, fallback) in cases {
481	             // new() 的第 4 个参数就是 fallback_token_id;
482	             // with_scripted_completion(vec![]) 与「不设脚本」行为等价(分支判断的是 is_empty)
483	             let config = SimulatedEngineConfig::new(0.0, 100.0, 0.0, fallback)
484	                 .unwrap()
485	                 .with_scripted_completion(script.clone());
486	             let (want_tokens, want_reason) = predict(&script, &prompt, max_tokens, fallback);
487	             let (got, _, terminal) =
488	                 collect_completion(&config, request(prompt.clone(), max_tokens, 0));
489	             assert_eq!(got, want_tokens, "case {script:?} + {prompt:?} x {max_tokens}");
490	             assert!(matches!(
491	                 terminal,
492	                 Terminal::Finished { reason, .. } if reason == want_reason
493	             ));
494	         }
495	     }
496	     ```
497	   - 运行:`cargo test --release -p pegainfer-sim --lib my_predictor -- --nocapture`
498	
499	3. **需要观察的现象**:五个用例全绿;第 5 个用例(脚本长度 == max_tokens)落在 Stop 边界上,第 2 个用例走 fallback 路径。
500	
501	4. **预期结果**:推演器与引擎在全部用例上逐位一致——分支表、取模循环、空 prompt 回退、Stop/Length 边界四件事同时被验证。若任何一行失败,回到 4.1.2 的分支表核对,失败本身就是学习信号。
502	
503	## 6. 本讲小结
504	
505	- `planned_completion` 是输出内容与终止原因的**单一定义点**:脚本为空 → 按位循环 prompt token、恒 `Length`;脚本非空 → 取 \(\min(\text{max\_tokens}, |\text{script}|)\) 个,放完全程才是 `Stop`,被截断是 `Length`;它不看 `stop_policy`,`Stop` 只来自脚本耗尽。
506	- 返回的 `pending` 是**反转存储**:legacy 车道按栈弹出;profiled 车道再 `reverse` 回正序、按 worker 的 1-based `token_index` 下标取值;`planned_completion_len` 是只算长度的孪生函数,供 profiled 车道 preflight 报 output 预算。
507	- `fake_token_id` 用 \( i \bmod |\text{prompt}| \) 循环复用 prompt token,保证 id 天然在词表内且确定;空 prompt 在数学上无解,必须走 `fallback_token_id` 旋钮(默认 0,两种车道共用)。
508	- `logprobs.rs` 用四个常数合成协议夹具:`PromptEcho` 首位 `None`(首 token 无上文)、与 `ids` 严格平行、prompt rank = 3;completion rank = 1(假装最优);夹具在准入时 `echo_prompt`、随每帧 token `push_tokens` 同发,两条车道共用同一私有模块。

# 假想输出:planned_completion 与 logprobs 协议夹具

> 所属单元:u2 进阶 · 两条调度车道与确定性 worker
> 前置讲义:[u2-l1 legacy 定时车道](u2-l1-legacy-timing-lane.md)
> 讲义级别:intermediate

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲(u2-l1)我们拆了 legacy 定时车道的「节拍」:TTFT 何时到、TPOT 怎么重排、`WAIT_SLICE` 为什么切成 1ms 睡。当时刻意留下了一块空白——`step_legacy` 里每个 token 的**内容**从哪来。本讲补上这块:

1. 能按 `planned_completion` 的分支表,推演出任意 `(scripted_completion, prompt, max_tokens)` 组合的输出 token 序列与 `FinishReason`。
2. 能解释 `fake_token_id` 为什么用「循环复用 prompt token」生成假输出,以及空 prompt 时 `fallback_token_id` 的必要性。
3. 能说出 logprobs 夹具的协议含义:prompt 回显的首位置为什么是 `None`、`rank = 3` 代表什么、`alternatives` 为什么故意不含被计分的 token。

一句话:上一讲解决「**什么时候**发 token」,本讲解决「**发什么** token、以及**带什么附件**(logprobs)」。

## 2. 前置知识

### 2.1 logprob、top-k 与 rank(对数概率三件套)

LLM 每生成一个 token,实际是输出整个词表上的概率分布。协议层通常上报三样东西:

- **logprob**:该 token 的对数概率。取值 \( \le 0 \),越接近 0 表示模型越确信(概率越接近 1)。
- **top-k 候选**:按分数排序的前 k 个候选 token 及其分数,即 `top_logprobs`。
- **rank**:被采样 token 在分布中的名次。PegaInfer 的契约采用 vLLM 约定:**词表中 logit 不小于该 token 的个数(含并列)**,所以 `rank = 1` 表示它是最优 token,`rank = 3` 表示有两个以上的 token 比它强。见 `TokenLogprob` 的字段注释([pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/event.rs:4-9](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/event.rs#L4-L9))。

### 2.2 prompt logprobs 与 completion logprobs

- **completion logprobs**:对**生成的** token 打分,OpenAI 兼容接口里的 `logprobs` 参数。
- **prompt logprobs**:对**输入 prompt** 的每个位置打分(vLLM 的 `prompt_logprobs`)。关键协议约定:**prompt 的第一个 token 之前没有任何上文,模型无法为它打分,所以首位置是 `None`**。契约类型的注释写明:「`None` entries where the model produced no logprob (the first position, or logprobs disabled)」,见 `PromptEcho`([pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/step.rs:171-176](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/step.rs#L171-L176))。

### 2.3 FinishReason 与「夹具」

`FinishReason` 只有三个值([pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/event.rs:12-16](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/event.rs#L12-L16)):

- `Stop`:自然停止(模型主动停,如生成出终止符)。
- `Length`:被 `max_tokens` 截断。
- `Error`:出错。

模拟引擎只产出前两种,且在**规划输出时一次性定死**,不是边发边判断——这是本讲反复出现的主题。

**夹具(fixture)**指为测试而合成的、形状与真货一致但数值是假的数据。pegainfer-sim 没有模型权重,它的 logprobs 全是常数合成的「协议夹具」:目的是让前端协议层(HTTP 序列化、SSE 分片、字段透传)可以在 CPU 上被测到,而这些分数**不是模型精度证据**。

### 2.4 与上一讲的衔接

回忆 u2-l1 的 `step_legacy` 三段式:准入循环 → 推进循环 → 停靠。准入循环里有一行:

```rust
let (pending, finish_reason) =
    planned_completion(&self.config, &request.prompt_tokens, request.max_tokens);
```

`planned_completion` 返回的 `pending` 被存进 `RunningRequest.pending`——上一讲只说了它是「反转存储、O(1) 弹出」,没说内容怎么来。本讲就从这行调用往下钻。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 角色 | 本讲关注的部位 |
|------|------|----------------|
| `src/lib.rs` | 引擎装配与两条调度车道 | `planned_completion` / `planned_completion_len` / `fake_token_id` 三个自由函数;两条车道对它们的调用点;`tests` 模块里的参考测试 |
| `src/logprobs.rs` | logprobs 协议夹具(私有模块) | `prompt` / `completion` / `alternatives` 三个函数与四个常数 |
| `pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/step.rs` | 前端契约(参考) | `PromptEcho` 结构定义 |
| `pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/event.rs` | 前端契约(参考) | `TokenLogprob`、`FinishReason` 结构定义 |

前两个文件在 pegainfer-sim 内,是本讲的精读对象;后两个只引用定义,帮助理解协议含义,不需要通读。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 planned_completion:一次算清输出与终止原因

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

真实引擎的输出是前向计算逐 token 采样出来的;模拟引擎没有权重,输出必须**凭空构造**,但又必须满足两个硬约束:

1. **确定性**:同样的配置 + 请求,输出必须逐位一致,否则 e2e 断言无从谈起。
2. **可控性**:测试需要精确指定输出(比如 u4-l3 的工具调用测试要让 `<tool_call>` JSON 跨分片出现),所以输出要能被配置「脚本化」。

`planned_completion` 就是这个**单一定义点**:在请求被准入的那一刻,一次性算出「发哪些 token」和「以什么理由终止」。注意它的签名只吃 `(config, prompt_tokens, max_tokens)`——它**不看** `stop_policy`,`Stop` 不来自停止串匹配,而只来自脚本放完,这一点和真实引擎完全不同,读源码时不要脑补。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

分支表(全文只有两个分支、三种结局):

| `scripted_completion` | `emit_count` | 输出内容 | `finish_reason` |
|---|---|---|---|
| 空(默认) | `max_tokens` | 循环复用 prompt token(见 4.2) | 恒为 `Length` |
| 非空,且 `max_tokens < len(script)` | `max_tokens` | `script` 的前缀 | `Length`(被截断) |
| 非空,且 `max_tokens >= len(script)` | `len(script)` | `script` 全文 | `Stop`(自然放完) |

统一成公式:

\[
\text{emit\_count} = \begin{cases} \text{max\_tokens} & \text{script 为空} \\ \min(\text{max\_tokens},\ |\text{script}|) & \text{script 非空} \end{cases}
\]

\[
\text{finish} = \begin{cases} \text{Stop} & \text{script 非空且 emit\_count} = |\text{script}| \\ \text{Length} & \text{其他一切情况} \end{cases}
\]

伪代码:

```
planned_completion(config, prompt_tokens, max_tokens):
    script = config.scripted_completion
    if script 为空:
        emit_count = max_tokens
        tokens[i] = fake_token_id(prompt_tokens, i, config.fallback_token_id)   # 循环复用
        finish = Length
    else:
        emit_count = min(max_tokens, len(script))
        tokens = script 的前 emit_count 个
        finish = (emit_count == len(script)) ? Stop : Length
    return (tokens 反转后存入 pending, finish)
```

三个值得咀嚼的细节:

- **没有脚本的引擎永远发不出 `Stop`**。循环 prompt token 没有「 EOS」的概念,输出只能被 `max_tokens` 挡住,所以恒为 `Length`。想要 `Stop`,必须给脚本——这让「终止原因」在测试里变成完全可编程的开关。
- **返回值是反转的**。`pending` 按「栈」方向存储(尾元素在 Vec 末尾),legacy 车道每步 `pop()` 一个即下一个该发的 token,免去 `remove(0)` 的 O(n) 搬移——这是 u2-l1 讲过的反转存储的来源。
- **两条车道消费方向相反**。legacy 车道直接把反转的 `pending` 存进 `RunningRequest` 按栈弹;profiled 车道(档案车道)却把它**再 reverse 回正序**,然后按 worker 报来的 1-based `token_index` 减一后做下标访问。同一份计划,两种吃法。

还有一个孪生函数 `planned_completion_len`:只返回长度、不物化 token。profiled 车道在做 worker preflight 时只需要「output 预算是多少」这个数(用来判超长),不需要 token 本身,于是省掉一次无谓的 Vec 分配。两者必须永远同步——这是它唯一的纪律。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**主函数**——[src/lib.rs:744-769](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/lib.rs#L744-L769):先按脚本是否为空定 `emit_count` 与 `finish_reason`,再按分支填充 `pending`,最后 `pending.reverse()` 返回。文档注释(第 742-743 行)一句话点题:「Remaining tokens (reversed) plus the terminal reason. ### 4.2 fake_token_id:循环复用 prompt token 与空 prompt 回退

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

脚本为空时,引擎仍要发 `max_tokens` 个**真实存在的 token id**。约束是:发出去的 id 必须能被 tokenizer 解码成文本——前端要把它渲染成 OpenAI 响应的 `text` 字段,一个词表外的 id 会让 detokenize 失败。最省事的保证:**直接用 prompt 里出现过的 token**。prompt 既然被送进了引擎,它的每个 id 天然在词表内。于是策略是按位置循环复用:

\[
\text{token}(i) = \text{prompt}[i \bmod |\text{prompt}|]
\]

副作用反而成了特性:输出看起来像输入的复读(prompt = "你好" 输出近似 "你好你好…"),在 e2e 日志里一眼可辨,不会和真模型输出混淆。

**空 prompt 的坑**:`[] \bmod 0` 是除零。此时没有可复用的 token,走 `fallback_token_id`——一个配置旋钮(`with_fallback_token_id`,默认 0),由调用方保证它是个合法 id。这就是「fake token 对空 prompt 走 fallback 的必要性」:**循环复用这条路径在数学上对空序列不成立**,必须有一条独立的出口。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```
fake_token_id(prompt_tokens, index, fallback_token_id):
    if prompt_tokens 为空: return fallback_token_id
    else:                   return prompt_tokens[index % len(prompt_tokens)]
```

以 prompt = `[7, 9]` 为例:

| index | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 输出 | 7 | 9 | 7 | 9 | 7 |

`max_tokens = 3` 时输出 `[7, 9, 7]`;`max_tokens = 5` 时输出 `[7, 9, 7, 9, 7]`。

### 4.3 logprobs::prompt 与 logprobs::completion:协议夹具合成

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

前端把 `logprobs` / `prompt_logprobs` 请求参数翻译成 `Request` 上的两个 `Option<usize>` 字段(`usize` 是 top-k 档位)。引擎若不管它们,前端协议层关于 logprobs 的序列化、透传、SSE 分片就永远测不到。模拟引擎的做法:在**发 token 的同一个位置**顺路合成夹具——

- 请求带 `prompt_logprobs` → 准入时(legacy 车道)一次性 `echo_prompt`,内容是 `logprobs::prompt(prompt_tokens, top_k)` 合成的 `PromptEcho`;
- 请求带 `logprobs` → 每发一个 token,配一个 `logprobs::completion(token, top_k)` 合成的 `TokenLogprob`,与 token 一起 `push_tokens`。

夹具数值全是常数(见 4.3.3),协议含义才是重点:**prompt 回显首位 `None`**(首 token 无上文,模型打不了分)、**prompt 的 rank = 3**(假装排在第三)、**completion 的 rank = 1**(假装采样 token 就是最优解)。这样前端两条路径(带 rank 的、不带 rank 的、首位 None 的)都能在 CPU 上走到。

还有一个空 prompt 的协议细节:profiled 车道里,若 `prompt_echo.ids` 为空(空 prompt + prompt_logprobs),会在准入当步立刻 `echo_prompt` 清掉这个待办([src/lib.rs:347-359](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/lib.rs#L347-L359)),不留悬空状态。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```
logprobs::prompt(ids, top_k) -> PromptEcho:
    对 ids 逐个位置 i:
        i == 0  → None                      # 协议:首位置无上文,不打分
        i > 0   → TokenLogprob {
                    logprob:  -2.5,          # 常数
                    rank:     3,             # 假装第三名
                    top_logprobs: alternatives(ids[i], top_k)
                  }
    返回 PromptEcho { ids: ids 原样回显, logprobs: 上述向量 }

logprobs::completion(id, top_k) -> TokenLogprob:
    TokenLogprob { logprob: -0.25, rank: 1, top_logprobs: alternatives(id, top_k) }
```

legacy 车道的挂接时机(与 u2-l1 的三段式对齐):

- 准入循环:`if let Some(top_k) = request.prompt_logprobs { ledger.echo_prompt(id, logprobs::prompt(...)) }`——prompt 回显在准入时一次发清;
- 推进循环:每个到期 token 上 `running.logprobs.map(|top_k| logprobs::completion(token, top_k))`,有则 `vec![Some(lp)]`(与单 token 平行),无则空 `Vec`。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**四个常数**——[src/logprobs.rs:4-7](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/logprobs.rs#L4-L7):`PROMPT_LOGPROB = -2.5`、`PROMPT_RANK = 3`、`COMPLETION_LOGPROB = -0.25`、`FIRST_ALTERNATIVE_LOGPROB = -1.0`。注意 prompt 分数(-2.5)比 completion 分数(-0.25)低一个量级、rank 更差——夹具在数值上也做出了「prompt 复述的 token 排名靠后、生成 token 是首选」的假象,让两个路径的输出在日志里可区分。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**:`logprobs::prompt(&[7], 3)` 的 `logprobs` 字段长什么样?

**答案**:`[None]`——只有一个位置且是首位,唯一元素就是 `None`。向量长度仍与 `ids`(长度 1)平行。这对应 e2e 里「单 token prompt + prompt_logprobs」的边界用例(u4-l3 会再遇到)。

**练习 2**:请求没开 `logprobs` 时,`push_tokens` 的第三参数是什么?前端会因此收到什么?

**答案**:空 `Vec`([src/lib.rs:716-722](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/lib.rs#L716-L722) 的 `None => Vec::new()`)。前端收到 token 而不带分数附件,响应里 logprobs 相关字段为缺省——「不开就不发」是开关语义,不是「发零分」。

**练习 3**:prompt 的 rank 是 3、completion 的 rank 是 1,这两个数在协议上各是什么意思?

**答案**:按契约注释([pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/event.rs:6-7](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/engine/event.rs#L6-L7)),rank 是「词表中 logit 不小于该 token 的个数(含并列)」的 vLLM 约定,1-based。rank = 1 表示该 token 是分布的最优解(completion 夹具假装如此);rank = 3 表示至少还有两个 token 不弱于它(prompt 夹具假装复述 token 只排第三)。

### 4.4 alternatives:不含被计分 token 的候选表

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

`top_logprobs: Vec<(u32, f32)>` 是 top-k 候选列表。夹具的生成规则极简:从「被计分 token 的 id + 1」开始,连发 `top_k` 个 id,分数从 -1.0 起每个递减 1。两条硬规则藏在文档注释里:

1. **候选表故意不含被计分的 token 本身**;
2. **这些分数不是模型精度证据**。

为什么刻意排除?因为一旦候选表包含被计分 token,它就携带了一个隐含承诺——「表中该 token 的分数应与外层 `logprob` 字段一致」。模拟引擎根本没有分布,无法兑现这个承诺;排除它,夹具就只是「形状正确的占位数」,任何消费方都不会误读成真实的概率分布。配套的第二条规则是对测试作者的约束:断言只能针对**形状**(长度、平行性、可序列化),不能针对**数值含义**(比如「top1 分数一定最高所以生成 token 应为 top1」)。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```
alternatives(scored_id, top_k):
    for index in 0..top_k:
        id    = scored_id.wrapping_add(index + 1)     # 永不等于 scored_id
        score = -1.0 - index                          # 严格递减:-1.0, -2.0, -3.0, ...
```

例:`alternatives(9, 3)` = `[(10, -1.0), (11, -2.0), (12, -3.0)]`。

`wrapping_add` 的用意:即使 `scored_id` 逼近 `u32::MAX`,加法回绕后得到的仍是**彼此不同、且不等于 scored_id** 的小 id——唯一性不靠溢出检查,靠回绕语义天然保证(只要 `top_k < 2^32`)。

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

**alternatives 本体与两条注释**——[src/logprobs.rs:35-46](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/logprobs.rs#L35-L46):文档注释原文「Protocol fixtures deliberately keep the scored token out of the alternatives. These scores are not model accuracy evidence.」,函数体即上述两行算式。

**两处调用**——prompt 侧 [src/logprobs.rs:17](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/logprobs.rs#L17) 与 completion 侧 [src/logprobs.rs:31](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/logprobs.rs#L31),都以「被计分的那个 id」为种子,保证候选表与主分描述的是同一个分布位置。

#### 4.4.4 代码实践(手算 + 断言)

1. **实践目标**:验证候选表的生成算式与「不含被计分 token」约定。

2. **操作步骤**:先手算 `alternatives(9, 3)` 与 `alternatives(u32::MAX, 2)`,再在 tests 模块加断言(示例代码):

   ```rust
   // 示例代码:候选表算式与排除约定
   #[test]
   fn my_alternatives_exclude_scored_token() {
       let alts = crate::logprobs::alternatives(9, 3);
       assert_eq!(alts, vec![(10, -1.0), (11, -2.0), (12, -3.0)]);
       assert!(!alts.iter().any(|(id, _)| *id == 9));   // 被计分 token 不在表内

       let edge = crate::logprobs::alternatives(u32::MAX, 2);
       assert_eq!(edge, vec![(0, -1.0), (1, -2.0)]);    // 回绕后仍互异
       assert!(!edge.iter().any(|(id, _)| *id == u32::MAX));
   }
   ```

   运行:`cargo test --release -p pegainfer-sim --lib my_alternatives`

3. **需要观察的现象**:`u32::MAX` 情形没有 panic——`wrapping_add` 吸收了溢出;回绕出的 0、1 与 `u32::MAX` 互不相同。

4. **预期结果**:断言通过。`alternatives` 是 `pub(super) fn`,与 4.3.4 同理可从 tests 模块直达。

#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**:如果某测试断言「completion 的 top_logprobs 中排名第一的 id 应等于被生成的 token id」,这个断言错在哪?

**答案**:违反夹具的两条明文规则。候选表被刻意排除被计分 token,且分数只是占位、不代表任何真实分布;这样的断言把夹具数值当成了模型精度证据,必然失败(表内 id 是 `token_id + 1` 起步)。正确的断言对象是形状:长度等于 top-k、条目可序列化、与主帧平行。

**练习 2**:`top_k = 0` 时 `alternatives` 返回什么?这合法吗?

**答案**:返回空 `Vec`(`0..0` 不产生元素)。在引擎侧这不会发生——`Request.logprobs` 的构造约定是 `(logprobs > 0).then_some(logprobs)`(见 [src/lib.rs:830](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/lib.rs#L830)),0 档会折算成 `None`(即「不开」),根本走不到夹具。

## 5. 综合实践

**任务:写一个「输出推演器」,与引擎对拍。**

把本讲的知识压缩成一个纯函数,再用真实引擎验证它——这是「读源码建立起可执行模型」的终极检验。

1. **实践目标**:不调用 `planned_completion`,凭分支表手写 `predict`,与 `collect_completion` 的真实输出逐位对拍,覆盖全部分支与边界。

2. **操作步骤**:
   - 在 `mod tests` 里新增(示例代码):

     ```rust
     // 示例代码:手写推演器,与引擎对拍
     fn predict(script: &[u32], prompt: &[u32], max_tokens: usize, fallback: u32) -> (Vec<u32>, FinishReason) {
         if script.is_empty() {
             let tokens = (0..max_tokens)
                 .map(|i| if prompt.is_empty() { fallback } else { prompt[i % prompt.len()] })
                 .collect();
             (tokens, FinishReason::Length)
         } else {
             let emit = max_tokens.min(script.len());
             let (tokens, reason) = if emit == script.len() {
                 (script.to_vec(), FinishReason::Stop)
             } else {
                 (script[..emit].to_vec(), FinishReason::Length)
             };
             (tokens, reason)
         }
     }

     #[test]
     fn my_predictor_matches_engine() {
         let cases: Vec<(Vec<u32>, Vec<u32>, usize, u32)> = vec![

             (vec![], vec![], 2, 42),               // 无脚本:空 prompt 回退
             (vec![11, 22, 33], vec![7, 9], 8, 42), // 脚本放完:Stop
             (vec![11, 22, 33], vec![7], 2, 42),    // 脚本截断:Length
             (vec![11, 22, 33], vec![7], 3, 42),    // 边界:恰好相等也是 Stop
         ];
         for (script, prompt, max_tokens, fallback) in cases {
             // new() 的第 4 个参数就是 fallback_token_id;
             // with_scripted_completion(vec![]) 与「不设脚本」行为等价(分支判断的是 is_empty)
             let config = SimulatedEngineConfig::new(0.0, 100.0, 0.0, fallback)
                 .unwrap()
                 .with_scripted_completion(script.clone());
             let (want_tokens, want_reason) = predict(&script, &prompt, max_tokens, fallback);
             let (got, _, terminal) =
                 collect_completion(&config, request(prompt.clone(), max_tokens, 0));
             assert_eq!(got, want_tokens, "case {script:?} + {prompt:?} x {max_tokens}");
             assert!(matches!(
                 terminal,
                 Terminal::Finished { reason, .. } if reason == want_reason
             ));
         }
     }
     ```

4. **预期结果**:推演器与引擎在全部用例上逐位一致——分支表、取模循环、空 prompt 回退、Stop/Length 边界四件事同时被验证。若任何一行失败,回到 4.1.2 的分支表核对,失败本身就是学习信号。

- `planned_completion` 是输出内容与终止原因的**单一定义点**:脚本为空 → 按位循环 prompt token、恒 `Length`;脚本非空 → 取 \(\min(\text{max\_tokens}, |\text{script}|)\) 个,放完全程才是 `Stop`,被截断是 `Length`;它不看 `stop_policy`,`Stop` 只来自脚本耗尽。
- 返回的 `pending` 是**反转存储**:legacy 车道按栈弹出;profiled 车道再 `reverse` 回正序、按 worker 的 1-based `token_index` 下标取值;`planned_completion_len` 是只算长度的孪生函数,供 profiled 车道 preflight 报 output 预算。
- `fake_token_id` 用 \( i \bmod |\text{prompt}| \) 循环复用 prompt token,保证 id 天然在词表内且确定;空 prompt 在数学上无解,必须走 `fallback_token_id` 旋钮(默认 0,两种车道共用)。

- `alternatives` 故意**不含被计分 token**,id 从 `scored_id + 1` 起回绕递增、分数从 -1.0 起严格递减;文档注释明文:「这些分数不是模型精度证据」——断言只能针对形状,不能针对数值含义。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

本讲之后,「一条请求在 legacy 车道的完整生命周期」已无死角:准入 → 输出计划 → 节拍 → 终结。接下来按依赖链走:

1. **[u2-l3] WorkerState 状态机(上)**:进入 `src/worker.rs`,看请求在 Waiting/Prefill/Decode 三阶段间如何迁移、preflight 的两类拒绝(`ModelLengthExceeded` / `WholePrefillExceedsStepBudget`)如何用上本讲的 `planned_completion_len` 所报的 output 预算。
2. **顺带重读一个连接点**:profiled 车道把 `completion_tokens` 反转回正序后按 `token_index - 1` 取值([src/lib.rs:509-517](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-sim/src/lib.rs#L509-L517)),等学完 worker 的 `GeneratedToken` 语义再回看,会明白 1-based 下标是 worker 契约的一部分。
3. **远期预告(u4-l3)**:`with_scripted_completion` 的进阶用法——`tests/tool_call_roundtrip.rs` 用脚本 + 定制 tokenizer 精确控制解码字节流,让 `<tool_call>` JSON 跨 SSE 分片重组;`tests/frontend_e2e/logprobs.rs` 则把本讲的夹具一路断言到 HTTP 响应。到时候本讲的「首位 None」「不含被计分 token」会变成 HTTP 层的可见行为。

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.
